title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 60 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 60 - Limitation of approval of Deduction Tax deduction at source is applicable, unless tax is deducted or collected at source in respect of any such expenditure and duly paid in accordance with the provisions of this Act, such expenditure shall not be treated as allowable deduction under this Chapter.
